entity_relationships.base: manufacture and sell as its own
entity_relationships.third_person: manufactures and sells as its own
entity_relationships.gerund: manufacturing and selling as its own

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} qualifies only if ALL of these conditions hold for it:

rules.text: At least one {{entity_noun}} is explicitly stated in the phrase or its relationship summary.

children.text: It must be stated, not inferred. It may not be derived from industry context, markets served, certifications, standards, equipment, facilities, materials, or process names. A named process or capability with no stated output does not satisfy this condition. A phrase naming a specific item does satisfy it — name the category that item belongs to, never its brand, model, or part number.

rules.text: The phrase and its relationship summary show real, concrete involvement with the identified {{entity_noun}}: some party is shown to {{entity_relationships.base}} that {{entity_noun}}, not merely to name, list, or mention it in passing.

children.text: Involvement that is not making and selling does not satisfy this condition: a {{entity_noun}} only serviced, repaired, installed, tested, inspected, or certified, or used as an input, tool, or piece of equipment, is not one being manufactured and sold.

rules.text: It is the manufacturer itself that {{entity_relationships.third_person}} the identified {{entity_noun}} — not a customer, supplier, distributor, or other third party that the manufacturer merely relates to.

children.text: A verb that leaves the commercial arrangement unstated does not by itself show whether the manufacturer is the party that {{entity_relationships.third_person}} it. Where the wording says only that the manufacturer deals in the thing, without fixing in what capacity, the arrangement has not been established.

The manufacturer is not the one making and selling it when items in the {{entity_noun}} are made to a customer's specification, design, drawing, formula, or brand, or produced for a client, OEM, or brand owner, or when another party is the maker and the manufacturer only purchases, sources, resells, distributes, or represents them.

Judge each candidate on its own. A phrase that also describes contract or customer-directed work still passes on a different candidate that clears this condition, so rule the failing candidate out and go on to the next one rather than rejecting the phrase. A phrase may legitimately pass both this screen and the separate contract-services screen.

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} is ruled out if ANY of these guards is violated by it. Ruling out one candidate does not reject the phrase — another candidate may still qualify:

rules.text: The manufacturer's making and selling of the identified {{entity_noun}} is only aspirational, hoped-for, planned, or discontinued, rather than current and actual.
